answer.reason: The verses tell of Delilah's pressing Samson for the secret of his strength and betraying him to the Philistines.

clauses.english: pressed Samson daily until he told her the secret of his great strength
clauses.quote: she pressed him daily with her words, and urged him

clauses.english: had Samson's seven locks shaved off while he slept, and called the Philistine lords to take him
clauses.quote: she caused him to shave off the seven locks of his head
